title: 'Purpose without power is just poetry'
summary: James DeVaney names Incorruptible book #32 of his #52Books2026 challenge and publishes a multi-paragraph review calling it one of the most thought-provoking books he's read this year on organizational design and leadership. Highlights Ries's 'mission lock' concept — designing governance, incentives, and decision-making so an organization's purpose endures through leadership transitions and market pressures — and the frame that resonated most with him: your organization is your best product.
blockquote: Ries asks how organizations stay true to their mission? His answer is that purpose alone isn't enough. As he memorably puts it, "Purpose without power is just poetry."
